material_findings_fixed.issue: Empty [DONE] and incomplete choices could count as success, while n>1 combined streams made per-request timing and TPOT misleading. Tool metadata IDs alone counted as semantic output.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Require a single completed choice, recognize normal finish reasons, reject multi-choice payloads/events, preserve unknown token counts, count tool function text/name rather than bookkeeping.

material_findings_fixed.issue: Response iteration allocated an unbounded SSE line before size checks; output creation could fail after paid requests had already run; direct API callers bypassed credential URL checks.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Read bounded lines, reserve output exclusively before sending requests, and reuse URL/payload checks for public probe calls. Origin and /v1 API-base URLs work.

material_findings_fixed.issue: Profile metadata accepted booleans/noninteger ranks and disagreed with effective CLI topology/context; config/tokenizer/served-name overrides bypassed controlled identity fields; malformed provenance escaped diagnostics.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Validate typed profile fields, scalar CLI duplicates/aliases, exact rank and cap agreement, immutable revision shapes, external-draft identity and incomplete snapshots.

material_findings_fixed.issue: Synthetic speculative acceptance in vLLM JSON/dotted CLI or SYNTHETIC environment variables escaped SIMULAT-only environment guard.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Reject synthetic/simulated acceptance in environment and speculative arguments; verified official Kimi recipe documents these synthetic options.

material_findings_fixed.issue: Catalog/model.json divergence, unknown profile files, checkpoint/revision mismatch and nonstandard JSON escaped local validator.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Added matching model-copy check, profile variant/pin checks, duplicate/orphan checks and strict JSON duplicate/nonfinite rejection.

material_findings_fixed.issue: Wrong glm45 tool parser for GLM5.3 tool syntax.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Use glm47 for tool calls and retain glm45 reasoning; preserve compatibility-probe.

material_findings_fixed.issue: TP4 baseline was an arbitrary shape after an exact NVIDIA TP1 source recipe became available.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Align source TP1/FlashInfer linear attention/BF16 state flags; explicitly retain verified:false provenance and local conservative resource caps as a compatibility probe.

material_findings_fixed.issue: Renderer accepted invalid PVC names/selectors and claimed no credentials while Kubernetes token automount was left to defaults.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Validate names/labels and emit automountServiceAccountToken:false; qualify image validation as digest suffix/basic structure, not registry verification.

material_findings_fixed.issue: Dangling symlink destinations and rename replacement race contradicted never modifying an existing checkout.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Check symlinks and reserve each target with atomic exclusive mkdir, keeping only newly created incomplete checkouts after retrieval failures.

material_findings_fixed.issue: Malformed API/config JSON shapes failed without clear provenance boundaries.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Reject nonobject API/config JSON and invalid revision types; regression tests cover immutable mismatch, optional404, receipt roundtrip and incomplete snapshot.

material_findings_fixed.issue: All34model revision fields and external drafter pin were unset; GLM Flash exact-derivative audit gap was stale.
material_findings_fixed.fix: Applied independently verified exact publisher/exporter commits from model audit owners; updated derivative evidence/reason while preserving unexecuted status.
